rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: join:refrain.1.4: 449-strip800.jpg system 4 (bars 16-21), the refrain's row: line 5's first word is printed with a capital right after a full stop, a capital it takes anyway; the page prints no metre (449-strip0.jpg header) and the refrain has one row, so nothing tells the joined line apart. moveup:refrain.1.4: 449-strip800.jpg system 4, the refrain's row: the moved word follows a full stop and the word after it follows the moved word's exclamation mark, so both are capitalised anyway; with no metre printed, nothing shows which of the two opens the line. split:refrain.1.5: 449-strip800.jpg system 4, the refrain's row: the word the split would open a line with is printed with a capital right after a question mark, a capital it takes anyway, and no metre is printed; nothing tells the split line apart. split:refrain.1.6: 449-strip800.jpg end of system 4, the refrain's row: the word the split would open a line with is printed with a capital right after a question mark, a capital it takes anyway, and no metre is printed; nothing tells the split line apart.
